versions.changelog:
cifer-security v1.0.0

- Initial release with full integration guide for CIFER SDK (quantum-resistant encryption).
- Covers SDK initialization, wallet setup, secret creation, text and file encryption/decryption.
- Supports Ethereum, Sepolia, and Ternoa blockchains.
- Includes error handling best practices and important usage notes.
- Describes wallet delegation and secret management workflow.
- References minimum required SDK version and payload size limits.
